title: O Jesus, to Thy Servants Give
description: O Jesus, to Thy Servants Give in Tonic Solfa to MELITA, doh is C: the solfa with the words, staff notation, 2 verses and a piano.
about: John Brownlie translated these words from the Greek service books for Hymns of the Greek Church (Edinburgh and London, 1900).
The book printed the words without tunes. They are in Long Metre, six lines (8.8.8.8.8.8), and this page sets them to MELITA; any other Long Metre, six lines tune fits them as well.
underlay: O Je-sus, to Thy ser-vants give The con-sol-a-tion they re-quire; And when the cloud of trou-ble falls, With heav-enly hope their souls in-spire. Be ev-er near us, Christ, to bless And help us in Thy faith-ful-ness.

lines: O Jesus, to Thy servants give
And when the cloud of trouble falls,
With heavenly hope their souls inspire.
Be ever near us, Christ, to bless
And help us in Thy faithfulness.
As Thou wert with Thy saints of old,
Be with us, ever present, Lord;
Unite us to Thyself, we pray,
As Thou hast promised by Thy word;
Then we shall glorify and laud
The Holy Spirit sent by God.

source: John Brownlie, Hymns of the Greek Church (1900)
licence: Public domain: John Brownlie died in 1925.
credits: Translated by John Brownlie (1857–1925) from the Greek, public domain, as printed in Hymns of the Greek Church; set to MELITA by NoteFusion, as words-only hymn books were sung.
